description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct with haste named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Mishra's Warform's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
